requirements.text: The website shall include a section for High School Courses to show recommended curricula for high school students interested in CS and related careers.
The website shall provide an internal search function for the Get Real site.
The website shall provide an external search function for CS related outside sites.
The website shall include a listing with links to professional organizations such as ACM, IEEE, and key sub groups.
The website shall provide RSS feeds of current CS information.
The website shall provide an Ask a Grad or Prof FAQ section for users to get feedback on questions.
The website shall include a section titled Consider a CS Minor to provide information for students in medicine, law, business, and other professions.
The website shall be compatible with IE, Firefox, and Netscape browsers.
The system shall track and evaluate the hits and time spent on the website.

The website shall implement HTTPS for all traffic, enforce secure content security policies (CSP), and ensure all third-party integrations (RSS, search) are sanitized to prevent XSS and injection attacks.
The website shall load the homepage in under 2 seconds for 95% of requests on a standard broadband connection.
The website shall implement HTTPS for all traffic and ensure all third-party scripts (RSS/Search) are served over secure connections to prevent XSS.
The website shall achieve a page load time of less than 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent users.
Analytics tracking shall be implemented using asynchronous scripts to ensure that data collection does not increase page load time by more than 100ms.

OPEN: The 'Ask a Grad or Prof' FAQ feature introduces user-generated content or input, which is a significant attack vector. - The 'Ask a Grad or Prof' feature shall implement input validation, sanitization, and a moderation workflow to prevent the injection of malicious scripts or inappropriate content.

OPEN: The requirement to track user hits and time spent lacks privacy and data protection considerations. - The system shall collect analytics data in compliance with applicable privacy regulations (e.g., COPPA for minors), ensuring that no personally identifiable information (PII) is stored without explicit consent.

OPEN: The requirement for tracking hits and time spent does not specify the privacy compliance or data retention policy. - The system shall collect anonymous usage metrics in compliance with FERPA and relevant state privacy laws, with data purged after 24 months.

OPEN: The RSS feed requirement implies a manual dependency on staff time without defining the failure handling or automation. - The RSS feed shall be automatically updated via a server-side script to ensure availability without manual intervention.

OPEN: The PRD does not define the expected user load or traffic volume, which is critical for infrastructure planning. - The system shall support a peak concurrent user load of 500 users without degradation in response time.

OPEN: The PRD mentions video streaming but provides no performance requirements for video delivery. - Video content shall be delivered with a startup latency of less than 1 second and support adaptive bitrate streaming to accommodate varying network conditions.
